description: Meeting Copilot overlay (CP1 + drag/auto-answer/resize). macOS only — the overlay window and the global hotkey are macOS features. Registration is Rust-side; this capability keeps the guest bindings available if the webview ever drives it. Core (events/invoke) comes from the `default` capability, which lists the `copilot` window. The window-scoped permissions let the overlay drag itself (native window drag), resize itself (native edge/corner resize + the SE grip), and persist/restore its position AND size on-screen.
